title: A single ion conductive “plasticine-like” solid electrolyte combined with a modulated d-band center of interfacial zinc atoms for highly reversible zinc metal anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00737B, Paper
Kang Yan, Yongbo Fan, Xueya Yang, Xinyu Wang, Shengmei Chen, Weijia Wang, Mingchang Zhang, Huiqing Fan, Longtao Ma
We develop a “plasticine-like” solid electrolyte, which shows a high Zn2+ ion transfer number of 0.9 and contributes to an anti-catalytic indium-rich solid electrolyte interphase by modulating the d-band center of zinc atoms.
